quirks: BROKEN: route is dead. POST https://api.purch.xyz/x402/buy and the advertised backend GET .../api/agent/shop both return plain text '404 Not Found' with NO x402/402 payment challenge.
paymentAccepts is empty ([]) — there is no 402 challenge, so the endpoint cannot be paid for. Do not attempt to pay.
authMode is apiKey+paid — endpoint requires a provider API key which we do not have (violates no-API-key policy).
No inputSchema, no instructions, no managedResource — even if reachable, a real 'buy' would need product IDs/SKUs that are not discoverable.

Host api.purch.xyz was also unreachable (DNS timeout / fetch failed) from the QA sandbox; combined with prior broken status, treated as broken. Zero dollars spent.
usage.guide: This endpoint is broken and unusable. The advertised call POST https://api.purch.xyz/x402/buy returns no x402 payment challenge (paymentAccepts is empty), the underlying 'Agent Shop' backend returns a plain-text '404 Not Found', and the service requires a provider API key we do not have (authMode apiKey+paid). It was confirmed dead today (2026-06-08) and on prior independent probes. Do not call or pay it until the provider restores a payable route and the API-key requirement is removed.
